# Foundgine

Foundgine is a semantic execution layer for .NET.

Canonical description:
"Foundgine converts structured application intent into deterministic, authorization-preserving execution plans that can be executed by a physical provider."

## Core concepts

- Semantic Model — what the application exposes.
- Intent — what the caller requests.
- Authorization — what the caller is allowed to do.
- Execution Plan — what Foundgine intends to execute.
- Provider — what physically executes the plan.
- Evidence — what happened and why.

## Architecture

Intent source → Semantic Intent → Resolution → Authorization → Execution Plan → Provider → Result + Evidence

## Boundaries

The core must not depend on GraphQL, Hot Chocolate, SQL, EF Core, OpenAI, MCP, or another transport/provider implementation.

GraphQL, JSON, AI, and application code are intent sources. SQL and other physical systems are execution providers.

## AI

AI is a consumer of Foundgine, not the definition of the core. AI may generate structured intent; Foundgine remains responsible for semantics, authorization, planning, execution, and evidence.

Foundgine exposes a policy-scoped semantic capability graph through `DescribeCapabilities()`. It describes entity, field, and relationship read/write access for callers such as AI adapters. Capability discovery is descriptive and never grants authorization; execution evaluates the policy again.

## ORM distinction

An ORM maps application objects to persistence. Foundgine maps structured application intent to authorized executable operations. Foundgine does not provide change tracking, identity maps, lazy loading, entity materialization, or migrations.

## Projects

- Foundgine.Abstractions — stable cross-layer contracts and IDs
- Foundgine.Metadata — domain and storage metadata
- Foundgine.Semantics — semantic model, intent, resolution, and authorization
- Foundgine.Planning — provider-independent execution planning
- Foundgine.Execution — execution contracts and result materialization
- Foundgine.Sql — SQL execution provider
- Foundgine.InMemory — deliberately small CLR-backed proof provider
- Foundgine.Aot / Foundgine.Aot.Generator — compile-time metadata
- Foundgine.Intent.Json — JSON intent adapter
- Foundgine.GraphQL.HotChocolate* — GraphQL adapters

## Current proof

The active repository proves semantic modelling and resolution, authorization, provider-independent query and mutation planning, SQL/SQLite execution, a small in-memory execution provider, nested traversal, deterministic plan fingerprints, execution evidence, AOT metadata generation, JSON intent, and Hot Chocolate GraphQL adapters.

Do not claim autonomous-agent execution, workflow orchestration, rollback/compensation semantics, universal provider support, or benchmark superiority unless later implementation and tests establish those claims.

Historical material under archive/ is not part of the active runtime or current product identity.
